name: talk_load
note: Loads the NPC_MES file named by DAT_800796bf and, for the five party files, runs the greeting selector (0x33 greet_guy ... 0x37 greet_zaril).

name: greet_guy
note: Guy's greeting selector: builds greet_flags and returns the greeting block.

name: greet_balbo
note: Balbo's greeting selector.

name: greet_fontana
note: Fontana's greeting selector.

name: greet_cresson
note: The scholars' greeting selector; sets oneshot_flags bit 4 on the maze-changed greeting and talk_flags 8 on the first.

name: greet_zaril
note: Zaril's greeting selector; talk_flags 0x10 marks the first meeting.

name: greet_bergamot_line
note: Bergamot's greeting line (4:9-13, 4:134): ages, all spells known, Decipher started, names Marguda and Arabik, one exact stat line.

name: greet_cresson_line
note: Cresson's greeting line (4:14-16, 18, 21): a member named DIMGUIL, max HP > 9999, level >= 100; else 4:18 (4:19/20 never chosen).

name: greet_cleo_line
note: Cleo's greeting line: talk_str_b = 0x38/2/4.

name: greet_fritillaria_line
note: Fritillaria's greeting: 5:16 if 10000+ kills, 5:17 if 10+ deaths (names the wrong member: searches kills, runs to index 6), else 5:13-15.

name: greet_gaura_line
note: Gaura's greeting: 5:18 or 5:19.

name: talk_chat_builder
note: Builds Guy's chat-topic script array (state 0x28).

name: talk_farewell_builder
note: Builds Guy's farewell script array (40-byte blocks).

name: npc_cure
note: Talk opcode 9: cure n on a roster index: 0 Dios 2d4, 1 Dialko (clear 0x20), 2 Dial 2d8, 3 Latumofis (clear 4, poison = 0), 4 Dialma 3d8, 5 Madi (clear 0x64, full HP), 6 Kadorto (clear 0x180, full HP; no roll, no cost).

name: npc_sale
note: An NPC party's item sale from npc_sale_table set n: shows three items and the price, takes the gold (first member who can pay, else pooled), gives the item to the first free slot; returns -1 bought, -2 can't pay, -3 declined.

name: npc_sale_table
note: 54 sets of 3 item ids and a price (8 bytes each), copied to the stack by npc_sale.

name: portrait_load
note: Loads character n's portrait TIM into a free portrait slot (0x8007957c/d).

name: portrait_show
note: Talk opcode 0's fade-in of a portrait at x.

name: portrait_hide
note: Talk opcode 1's fade-out; returns -1 when done.

name: portrait_face
note: Talk opcode 3: sets a portrait's expression.

name: bit_test
note: Returns word >> n & 1.

name: decipher_score
note: Counts decipher_table entries where the guess for ancient letter i is A-Z letter i (0-26).

name: talk_narration
note: Draws a say2 string in the centered narration box.

name: pack_compact
note: Closes gaps in a character's pack: moves items and item_state down over empty (0xffff) slots.

name: npc_stage
note: Each NPC party's story stage, one bit per stage: Guy bits 1-3, Balbo 4-6, Fontana 7-9, Cresson 10-12; new game 0x492. Advanced by MAZE 0x800a45b0 on first entering deeper areas and by talk_scene_fontana_split / talk_scene_control_room; saved.

name: greet_flags
note: Bits a greeting selector builds for its choice (meaning per party in docs/re/C-talk.md); bit 0 is also 'compatible', tested for NPC sales.

name: talk_speaker
note: Which member of the NPC party speaks the greeting or farewell (random).

name: talk_str_a
note: NPC string number filled into a greeting's second say at run time.

name: talk_str_b
note: NPC string number filled into a say slot at run time (greetings, farewells, scene lines).

name: talk_topic_str
note: Guy's chat topic bar string (1:281-285).

name: talk_menu
note: The talk menu's options: 7 Talk/Fight/Leave, 5 Talk/Leave; bit 0 cleared after a heal or three sales.

name: talk_menu_cursor
note: Cursor on the talk menu.

name: talk_count
note: Talk presses this meeting (talk_cresson and talk_zaril only).

name: npc_sale_set
note: Set number for the next npc_sale, picked from progress_bits on yes; kept between talks.

name: talk_file
note: Table-2 index of the NPC text file a talk loads: 0x33-0x37 = NPC_MES1-5.

name: talk_narration_pending
note: Set by talk opcode 11 (say2); the scene handler then draws the narration box.
